A '''Sith acolyte''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who existed outside of the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] relationship of the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]]. Instead, they were [[Sith training|trained]] as a lesser [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who was not a true [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] but did adhere to its [[Code of the Sith/Legends|tradition]].

==Known acolytes==
[[File:Sith_Adept.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Sith adept]]
The redeemed [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] encountered several Sith acolytes in the [[Temple of the Ancients]] on [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]]. These acolytes were trained under [[Darth Malak]] and studied the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] in secret, guarded by a force field outside the temple.

During the time of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Reconstituted Sith Empire]], acolytes were tested by [[Overseer (Sith)|Sith Overseers]] before earning their place as proper [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] under a superior [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].

Acolytes were [[Sith training|trained]] by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] at the [[Sith Academy (Dathomir)|Dathomir Academy]] and the [[Sith Academy (Iridonia)|Iridonia Academy]].

The character [[Gamblor]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] Sith acolyte, appeared in ''[[Juo Deltar Faces Gamblor the Terrible]]'', a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] that was produced during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Force Contention">{{LivingForce|Forces of Cularin: Force Contention}}</ref>

[[File:SithAcolyte.jpg|thumb|180px|right|A Sith acolyte]]
[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was a Sith acolyte.<ref name="Insider Lords">[[Star Wars: Lords of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Lords of the Sith]]</ref> [[Galen Marek]] was also loosely referred to as a Sith acolyte due to his apprenticeship under [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who already had a master. Marek's [[Subject 1138|clone]] encountered [[Imperial Sith Acolyte]]s during his quest to find [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]]. These Sith Acolytes were trained on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].

The rank was also used by [[Darth Krayt]]'s reformed [[One Sith|Order]]. Its use may have been similar to that of the earlier Sith. Krayt referred to himself as a Sith Acolyte in his apprenticeship under [[XoXaan]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]] – [[Threat of the Conqueror]]'', a Sith acolyte card is mistakenly named "Sith Adept."
